text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Gooooooo!
Buena Vistaaaaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha... What massive cheers, as expected.
I'll turn every last one of them—into stunned silence!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh, Nakayama-san... what incredible drive...!
She's put everything on the line here... But—)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...I won't lose! I can't lose...!
—I'll live up... to everyone's feelings!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The protagonist of this dream is indeed this Umamusume!!
It's Buena Vista! Buena Vista has etched her name into the history of the Takarazuka Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, ...!
Haa... what a relief...!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Uwooh!
Nakayama's drive was incredible, but...!
Buena surpassed it...!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vistaaa!
Thank you for letting us dream...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (Yeah... Everyone's smiles are so dazzling...! This time for sure—)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(I'm getting closer to the magnificent view!
I lived up to everyone's expectations, didn't I—)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: —Now that it's come to this, I can't wait to see what they'll pull off next!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: "She showed her strength on the Tiara route, and conquered the dream race... Next, should we seek prestige?"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Like the Tenno Sho (Autumn)! The ultimate showdown for middle distance races...! I really want you to win it!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Buena-chaan!
Win the next one too--!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(...Just a little more, right?
Yeah... then, if I win the next one too—)
(—Can I truly satisfy it?)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Buena Vistaaa, great job!"
"Can't wait for your next race!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah... y-yes...!
Please cheer for me!

I thought I saw a shadow cross Buena Vista's expression for a split second.
Acting on that hunch, I was just about to speak to her—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Congrats.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I thought this was my chance to break you down...
but you were far more solid than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama-san...
Thank you so much for today!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Your running snapped me right back to attention.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I believe that's why we were able to hype things up so much.
Let's definitely race together again!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, I'll definitely have my revenge.
...Though that might have to wait a little while."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Truth is, I was planning to take you down and gather all eyes on me before challenging them... but maybe this turned out for the better.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Some no-name Umamusume conquers
—the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe. Doesn't that get your heart racing?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...!
The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, weren't there
high expectations for you last year?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
This was my goal right from the very start.
A view from the summit that no one in Japan has ever seen before—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
A longshot Umamusume will change history.
—Now is the time to fulfill my "promise" to Sensei.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: A promise, you say...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...This has nothing to do with you.
Just stay at the top until I get back—
little lady.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama-san,
you're taking on the "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe," aren't you?
choice_data_list: Yeah, if you win... it'd be an incredible achievement.
Yeah, if we win... it'd be an incredible feat, huh?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: A great feat...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Just like Spe-san and Vodka-chan.
A sight that brings sheer shock and fervor...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "...Both Desire-chan and Nakayama-san have a clear image of the sight they want to see."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
With so many, so truly many people
cheering me on now... if I keep on winning,
I'm sure I'll get to see that magnificent view too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Just a moment ago... just for a tiny second,
I wondered if everything would really be okay like this."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"But all of that just blew away!
If it's us, we can reach our dream...
I truly believe that!"

Buena Vista has a bright expression on her face.
I wonder why she was worried in the first place, but if anything happens, she'll surely talk to me about it right away.
choice_data_list: If anything happens, tell me right away.
If anything happens, tell me right away, okay?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course.
...I'll be counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, I haven't gotten one from you yet.
—Thank you!
After wrapping up post-race affairs, we talk briefly about our next goal in the quiet, deserted entrance.
choice_data_list: Is there a race you'd like to enter?
Any race you want to enter?

text_block_list.text:
During the summer, we'll have our usual training camp.
So our target race will be set after that,
sometime in the autumn.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hope...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I want to run the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!
I heard a voice telling me they want me to run it.
The Tenno Sho (Autumn) is a GⅠ race open to both Classic and Senior Class runners. It is a fitting next step for her after winning the Takarazuka Kinen.
choice_data_list: Alright, next up is the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
Alright, next up is the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
choice_data_list: You just keep running in more and more incredible races...!
You just keep running in more and more incredible races...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!
It feels like running straight down the royal road.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to everyone, I've been able to challenge
many big races... I'm so grateful.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Ah...! It's Buena-chan!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Congrats on the win~!"
"We'll be cheering for you in the next race too!"
"Can't wait to see you race after the summer!!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Everyone,
thank you so much for cheering for me today!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'll try even, even harder next time!
So—please, expect great things from me!
